why_it_matters: Transfers raw document texts and active input edits to Grammarly remote servers, exposing private notes, emails, and inputs to remote collection. Family: text_capture.
reason: Transfers keystrokes and document content for real-time AI checking.

why_it_matters: Extension behavior, premium checking rules, and functional gates are driven by feature configurations dynamically loaded from remote config endpoints without Chrome Store update checks. Family: remote_config.
reason: Fetches gate rules and treatment settings from treatment.grammarly.com.

why_it_matters: Detailed and granular button-click tracking, interaction timings, and local usage metadata are continually pushed to multiple telemetry and logging endpoints, building detailed behavioral profiles. Family: telemetry_tracking.
reason: Buffers click actions and flushes telemetry batches periodically.

risk_name: Excessive Host and Sensitive API Permissions
why_it_matters: Requests permission to access all URLs and sensitive APIs, granting the extension unlimited page reading and modification scope, which poses a severe hijacking security risk. Family: security_sensitive_code.
reason: Broad host permissions allow wide context modification.

why_it_matters: Credential and token manipulation locally. Family: auth_tokens.
reason: Mitigated by storing tokens securely and only transferring to Grammarly auth subdomains.

why_it_matters: tampering of cached operational states. Family: storage_persistence.
reason: Mitigated by storing non-sensitive telemetry data and operational states.

why_it_matters: Malicious frames sending spoofed messages. Family: messaging_rpc.
reason: Mitigated because ports are secured and bound only to Grammarly extension context.

risk_name: Incomplete Masking of Sensitive Input Fields
why_it_matters: Failure of regex-based DLP masking. Family: privacy_sanitization.
reason: Mitigated because active DLP masking blocks password, credit card, and custom attributes correctly.

risk_name: Privilege Escalation via Native Host Connection
why_it_matters: Compromising local desktop native application host. Family: native_external_bridge.
reason: Mitigated because nativeMessaging is optional and is only triggered by direct user connection steps.

why_it_matters: User prompts and document context are transmitted and processed by AI models. Family: ai_or_model_features.
reason: AI feature rewrites and prompt building are used for editing features.
